report.summary: All tagged claims are either fully supported by the cited DRHP excerpts or, in one case (tag 3), partially supported: p112 supports the long-term marketing arrangement with the corporate promoter but does not itself name '20 Microns Limited' (that name appears on p113/p155). No unsupported or wrong-source claims were found, and no untagged sentence was identified that carries a checkable company-specific fact needing a new citation. The report's sourcing is sound, with only a minor attribution refinement needed for the 20 Microns Limited name.
